about: RankUp Bounties move library. Ranks 1-200 in each category are bodyweight (household items only: mat, wall, chair, step, towel); ranks after 200 use a foam roller or resistance band (gear: true; anchor: true means the band is tied to a door or post). Each move lists the categories it belongs to with that category's rank (1 = most common), dose, unit and per-side flag. stars (1-5) rate how demanding a move is; a bounty's stars equal its highest-starred move. cautions are screening tags for later filtering (impact, deep-knee, neck-load, deep-backbend, loaded-spinal-flexion, advanced, wrist-load).
